Hymn 277: As I Search the Holy Scriptures
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: John Longhurst
Lyricist/Text Author: C. Marianne Johnson Fisher

This is hymn number 277 titled "As I Search the Holy Scriptures" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John Longhurst and the lyrics were written by C. Marianne Johnson Fisher.
